programme.title: Kampen om herredømme
programme.desc: Sjekk det flotte fotarbeidet og de dødsbra bevegelsene til alfadyrene. En sørharehann slår til sin kjære, kanadatraner utfolder seg i dansekonkurranser, villgeiter stanger hodene mot hverandre i paringstiden, og leoparden er en mester i å skjule seg.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Opplev de sammenviklede livene til ville dyr påvirket av vulkaner, skog og sjø. Fly en tur med sjeldne apeørner mens de oppdrar ungene sine i et eldgammelt tre, for så å dykke ned i elven for å få et glimt av verdens sjeldneste krokodille.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Kast det ut i det krystallklare havet for å utforske Tubbataha-revet, som hviler på en inaktiv undervannsvulkan der grunne laguner gir beskyttelse for havskilpadder og tigerhaier. Kom deg opp i trærne med spøkelsesaper når de jakter insekter.

programme.title: Villmarkens voktere
programme.desc: 97 % av spissneshornene i Afrika har blitt drept på grunn av hornet. I 1997 ble arten offisielt erklært utryddet i Zambia, men nå er de tilbake, takket være en ambisiøs gjeninnføringsplan. Krypskytterne har ikke forsvunnet, og hornene er fortsatt verdt mye i asiatisk medisin. Men en liten, engasjert gruppe personer kjemper for at de skal være trygge. De utgjør frontlinjen i bevaringsarbeidet – og de har en tøff jobb.

programme.title: Det utemmede Zambia
programme.desc: I Luangwadalen står en gruppe ibenholttrær, som huser en flokk bavianer. Men det er farer her – leoparden har styrke og fleksibilitet til å klatre i trær, noe de andre rovdyrene ikke kan. Han er ikke en lett fiende å unngå.

programme.title: Det utemmede Zambia
programme.desc: Slettene og skogsområdene i Luangwadalen er de villeste og mest utilgivende av alle nabolagene der dueller mellom rovdyr og bytte utspiller seg både dag og natt. For dyrene som bor her er det en daglig kamp om å overleve.

programme.title: Dyrenes imperier
programme.desc: Gårdsdyrene er populære figurer i sanger og fortellinger, og hylles over hele verden. Men få historier forteller om søsterartene som lever vilt. Disse dyrene er primært kjent som buskap, pakkdyr eller til og med kjæledyr, og må klare seg selv utenfor gjerdene til sine tamme slektninger.

programme.title: Den levende stranden
programme.desc: Strendene i California er noen av de vakreste i verden, men holder balansen på å endres på grunn av menneskenes påvirkning på naturen? Hva skal til for at det fantastiske dyrelivet på Stillehavskysten skal fortsette å eksistere på den «levende stranden»?

programme.title: Claudio Abbado & Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: Mozart: Piano Concerto no. 12 - Vladimir Ashkenazy
programme.desc: The 13-part Mozart on Tour series chronicles the journey of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart across Europe. This broadcast features the first three episodes of this series, taking us to London, Mantua, and Bologna. In the first episode, Vladimir Ashkenazy performs as both soloist and conductor in Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 12, KV 414, accompanied by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra. The second episode features soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37, and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41. Holtmann is accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera, led by Marc Andreae. In the third episode, Andreae and his orchestra return for a performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 5, KV 175, featuring Malcolm Frager as the soloist.

programme.title: Pierre Henry is not dead
programme.desc: A pioneer of electronic music, Pierre Henry (1927-2017) has, since the 1950s, alongside Pierre Schaeffer, laid the foundations of what characterizes the music of our time. At the time, everything had to be invented: the sounds, the tools to manipulate them, the ways of broadcasting them. He influenced the pop music of the 1960s and 1970s, from the Beatles to Pink Floyd, and up to the DJs of the 1990s. He is the author of an absolute hit: the electronic jerks composed with Michel Colombier for the 'Messe pour present time' created by Maurice Béjart in 1967. But above all he is the creator of a prolific work, from the end of the 1940s to the 2010s, where pure and incredible sound experiences coexist with musical settings of texts to constitute mock operas of a new genre. Thanks to often unpublished documents, this documentary invites us to listen to Pierre Henry tell us about his journey and above all to listen to his music, one of the most innovative of the 20th century.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Prussian painter, Caspar David Friedrich. You will discover his labour with The Wanderer above the mists, Greifswald port or the Lone tree.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Spanish painter, Francisco de Goya. You will discover his labour with Lunch in the Countryside, The third of may 1808 or the Cannibals.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: William Blake (1757-1827) developed his own complex and personal mythology. He was a pre-romantic British painter, engraver and poet.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Established as a pictorial genre in its own right during the Renaissance, the female nude became one of the most important subjects in European painting. Under pretexts both mythological (Titian’s “Venus of Urbino”) and biblical (Rembrandt’s “Bathsheba at her Bath”) or Oriental (Ingres’“Great Odalisque”), the female body was unveiled. These pretexts vanish with Manet’s “Olympia”, a simple portrayal of a contemporary woman naked, which resulted in scandal.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Joyau de géométrie et de rigueur, cette bibliothèque est l'un des derniers chefs-d'œuvre de Louis Kahn. En disposant les lecteurs sur la périphérie du bâtiment, près de la lumière du jour, et en créant un immense hall central, Louis Kahn réinvente le plan de la bibliothèque. Achevée en 1971 dans la petite ville d'Exeter, dans l'État américain du New Hampshire, la bibliothèque de l'Exeter Academy forme un mystérieux monolithe de brique aux 4 façades identiques sur 8 étages.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rediscover the paintings of Jacob Jordaens. This artist is the subject of a special exhibition at the Petit Palais in 2013-1014.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Yan Gongda - The Art of Calligraphy
programme.desc: While the hieroglyphs of Egypt and the cuneiform of Babylon have disappeared, Chinese calligraphy, also graphic and non-alphabetic, has endured through the ages. Of divinatory origin, Chinese characters carry not only a language but a unique way of thinking. A 84th-generation descendant of one of Confucius’s best-known disciples, calligrapher Yan Gongda unrolls before our camera the timeless story of a writing art closer to painting than graphology. Through this story, the entire history of China is told.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Zakaria Abdelkafi, photojournalist. He is Syrian, correspondent for the French news agency in Aleppo from 2013 to 2015, and he is now based in Paris because, after a report in Turkey, he was unable to return to his country. He will tell us his story and how he became a photographer.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: En 1840, Turner a peint le chef-d'œuvre "Nuages et l'eau". Charlotte tente de comprendre son style libre, avec des taches épaisses. L'Anglais et violoncelliste Dominic Seldis vient faire résonner son violoncelle pour vanter les mérites de ce "Rembrandt britannique". Michel découvre que le tableau a subi un traitement précaire, mais se demande comment. En quête de réponses, l'équipe se rend à la Tate Britain puis sur une falaise anglaise venteuse. Un épisode dans lequel un fer à repasser, un rocher de craie à Margate et un pot de cire d'abeille jouent un rôle prépondérant.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story
programme.desc: Perhaps the most well-known fact about Vincent's troubled life is that he cuts his ear. Dive into the horrifying story of what it is that inspires him to do something so drastic.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: During the Renaissance the male body was portrayed less frequently than its female counterpart. With the advent of studies at the French Academy in Rome, the male nude became, on the contrary, the most important exercise for the student painter, to the point where a work portraying a naked man became known as “Academy Study”. Look at the figure in “Charon Ferrying the Shades” by Subleyras or the “Male Nude or Hector” by David. The male nude also represents the heroic nude, for example in Ingres’ painting “Oedipus and the Sphinx”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The building constructed in Berlin by Daniel Libeskind raises the question of architecture's own limits: How to build where everything has been destroyed without erasing the traces of what has disappeared? Today, this museum is one of the largest in Europe and offers a testament to two millennia of Jewish history in Germany. More than a museum, it is a tribute to the millions of victims of the Holocaust.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Édouard Vuillard. You will discover his labour with Sleep, The Piano or Portrait de madame Henri Vaquez.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, (1525-1569) is one of the most renowned Flemish painters of the Renaissance. Although influenced by Italian art, his paintings maintained a typically Flemish tradition. A “peasant” painter, he depicted the lives of his country’s common folk as in the “Peasant Wedding”. In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Construite à l’aube du 20ème siècle, l’École d’Art de Glasgow est l’œuvre majeure du seul artiste britannique considéré comme précurseur de la modernité, Charles Rennie Mackintosh. Représentant le plus éminent du "Style de Glasgow

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tout à la fois peintre et diplomate, Pierre-Paul Rubens (1577-1640) fut un personnage essentiel dans l’Europe artistique du XVIIe siècle. Il créa de vastes compositions pour les familles princières d’alors, comme le cycle sur la vie de Marie de Médicis, aujourd’hui conservé au musée du Louvre. Il incarne la veine baroque du Nord de l’Europe, développant un style tout en mouvement et aux touches colorées lumineuses, comme dans l’Enlèvement des filles de Leucippe exposé à Munich.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Léonard de Vinci est l’un des artistes les plus adulés au monde. De nombreux films et séries documentaires se sont intéressés à son génie hors du commun, sans pour autant prêter attention à ce qu’il y a de plus parlant : son art. Les tableaux et dessins incomparables de Léonard de Vinci seront au centre de notre film et Exhibition on screen vous présentera la totalité des tableaux qui lui sont attribués. Marquant les 500 ans de la mort de ce génie, ce documentaire est une référence sur Léonard de Vinci, le premier à raconter son histoire dans sa globalité.

programme.title: Leonardo: The Mystery of the Lost Portrait
programme.desc: In 2008, the chance discovery in the South of Italy of an ancient portrait with strangely familiar features takes the art world by storm. Could this be an unknown self-portrait by Leonardo da Vinci? Controversy erupts among the experts. The implications of such a discovery have far-reaching consequences for our understanding of the work of this great Renaissance master.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Eric Bouvet, photo reporter. His interest in photography started at the age of 8 when he saw a live broadcast of the first images of the Apollo 11 landing on the moon. He then became interested in different subjects such as geopolitics, history, and finally became a photojournalist.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Elle a été peinte il y a près de 600 ans ; il s'agit de la "Vierge à la fontaine" de Jan Van Eyck. Bien qu'elle soit la préférée de Charlotte, elle atteint les limites de ses capacités. Les détails minutieux, l'utilisation particulière de la peinture à l'huile et les pigments à séchage lent lui jouent des tours. Tandis que l'équipe étudie la technique complexe de peinture à l'huile de Van Eyck, elle se rend également à Rome. À la recherche du bleu outremer, ils découvrent au Vatican l'impact de Van Eyck sur ses contemporains italiens et allument un cierge pour Charlotte à Santa Maria Maggiore.

programme.title: Women Painters, four centuries of struggle
programme.desc: Do the names of Rosa Bonheur or Artemisia Gentileschi ring any bell to you? Despite their skills, female painters were for long time ignored by art historians and remain unknown to the public. This documentary recalls the destinies and masterpieces of those women, between the 16th and the 20th century. Who are they? And what did they bring to the art field?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le curieux monde de Hieronymus Bosch
programme.desc: La ville natale de Bosch aux Pays-Bas ne possède pas de tableaux du peintre et pourtant, pour la grande exposition « Visions of Genius » qui a eu lieu à l’anniversaire de sa mort en 2016, le musée Noordbrabants a réussi à réunir la presque totalité des tableaux et dessins de Bosch. C’est en 2008 que le directeur du musée a commencé sa tournée dans les plus grands musées d’Europe et Etats-Unis pour en persuader les directeurs de prêter au musée Noordbrabants leurs œuvres, en échange d’un travail d’analyse et de recherche sur les tableaux en prêt. Ainsi « Hieronymus Bosch. Visions of Genius » a été l’exposition la plus ambitieuse dédiée au peintre hollandais. Ce documentaire sera une plongée dans l’univers étrange et visionnaire de Hieronymus Bosch.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In this episode we will decipher the most famous works of Johannes Vermeer. He was born in 1632 and lived his whole life in Delft. He painted mainly interior scenes, everyday life with middle-class people but also with servants. He is the author of "The Milkmaid

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1871, a giant fire ravaged Chicago, providing a unique opportunity for a young generation of American architects to break away from the old continent and invent in Chicago the new forms of a specifically American architecture.

programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons l’artiste Alain Godon. Des rivages de la France à la campagne anglaise, de parachutiste gérant de discothèque, Alain Godon a eu mille et une vies. Mais il est toujours resté peintre. C’est un peintre figuratif au coup de crayon naïf et gai, qui loin des modes, des courants et des engouements des musées, est plébiscité par de nombreux collectionneurs pour qui il travaille depuis son atelier à Waltham dans le Kent.

Commonly used in weight training, this method is perfect for intensifying muscle work while diversifying the effort. Expect a dynamic and demanding session to engage your muscles deeply.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Today, it's 26-year-old Aurélie who's throwing herself into the ring. Originally from Nice, France, she has been passionate about decorating since she was a little girl. She decided to leave her job as a window dresser to go back to school to study decoration. In life as in decorating, Aurélie knows where to go. In fact, she already has definite ideas about this week's theme, "urban jungle".

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, le potiron est à l'honneur. Luana Belmondo cuisine un velouté de potiron aux épices avec des sablés salés au parmesan. Et pour la suite, elle prépare des gnocchis de potiron avec une sauce au fromage onctueuse.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo invite son amie Eleonora Galasso pour une pizza party ! Elles vont d'abord préparer une pâte maison. Ensuite, elles cuisineront une capriciosa avec des anchois, des câpres et du jambon, ainsi qu'une pizza fritta avec de l’origan et de la sauce tomate.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 2
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 2
programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. Au Brésil, dans le château d’eau du Brésil où l’eau, d’une pureté exceptionnelle est menacée par l’exploitation du minerai de fer qui pollue la nappe phréatique. Et à.

programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.desc: In 10-year-old Chanda's village, everyone works in the mine. Young as she is, she's no exception to the rule. Every morning, at dawn, she starts her day at the mine. Only then can she put on her school uniform and start dreaming of somewhere else. She walks for an hour in the unbreathable atmosphere of one of the world's most polluted areas.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Erbol, 12, lives in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan. His horse, Bourou, is his only way to get to his school, located many miles away from the farm where he lives with his parents. Morning and evening, during the winter, he rides for three hours through a desert of ice.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Francklyn is 13, and Olivier, 14. Every Sunday they began a 5 hours walk in the sweltering heat, to reach the shack next to the school where they live away from their family.

France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.desc: Cho is 10 and lives among the misty mountains of North Vietnam. She is from the Hmong minority, mountaineers people with a singular identity. Every day, with her little sister, they cross perilous mountain paths and roam slippery rocks to reach their school.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est Gaëtan qui va tenter de prouver que l'As de la déco, c’est lui. Ce Lillois de 38 ans est un véritable autodidacte qui ose tout. Il n'a d’ailleurs pas hésité à revendre l'intégralité de son ancienne décoration moderne et épurée pour repartir à zéro du jour au lendemain. Passer d'une ambiance à l'autre, rien de plus facile pour Gaëtan !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine des pois chiches. Comme ils sont originaires du Moyen-Orient, elle décide de préparer des recettes libanaises. Au menu : fallafels avec des pois chiches, du kumquat, des épices, de la cannelle, et blettes aux pois chiches, persil, menthe et boulgour.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo met la Normandie à l'honneur ! Avec le président de la région, Hervé Morin, elle prépare des pommes pochées dans un sirop de cannelle, ainsi que des moules... à sa façon.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Dans ce volet, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lève le voile sur les produits achetés par les hommes. Presque tous nos achats ont une incidence directe sur notre environnement. Direction la Japon pour parler de l’impact des nouvelles technologies, puis la république du Congo à Bukavu pour la récolte du coltan. Comment notre consommation totale affecte-t-elle l'environnement ? Quelles marques permanentes imposons-nous à notre planète ? Comment différencier les achats utiles des achats inutiles ?

Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

Brian loves turning old furniture into new pieces, so Rosie offers tips on how to photograph and present his pieces for sale. James and Bridget have an alpaca farm and make yarn by spinning. Bridget learns about natural dyes, while James rushes to get production running with his sock-making machine. Mum-of-two Tracey is a paper crafter who makes original pieces for friends and family, but she urgently needs advice on pricing.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Three hobby crafters present their works for the first time at Brancepeth Castle Craft Fair in Durham. Occupational therapist Olivia dyes her own yarn and produces hand-woven pieces, ex-builder Neil makes quirky metal ornaments and Wendi now makes her own glass pieces uses the art of fusing - and for the fair she even learns the art of glass blowing.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol

Når elven plutselig tørker ut i 20 år, må alt liv tilpasse seg virkeligheten med en langvarig tørke.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Utstyrt med en bøtte og en slange prøver dr. Pol å hjelpe en hest som ikke får puste. På klinikken tar dr. Lisa imot en katt med flere lidelser, mens dr. Brenda behandler en annen katt. Da Charles blir bekymret for hunden sin, ber han faren om råd.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. En ung panda får sin første klatreundervisning, fargerike larver viser fram sine iøynefallende mønster, og verdens eneste giftige primat, dovenlorien, sniker seg til et lite måltid. De utrolige historiene gir et sjeldent innblikk i en bemerkelsesverdig verden.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Mysterious North: Land of Mountain Forests
programme.desc: Fra pangoliner, asiatiske palmesivetter og Delacours langurer til cat ba-langurer og de nylig oppdagede vitenamesiske krokodilleøglene. Vi ser på det utrolige utvalget av unike dyr som trives i de ekstreme forholdene som finnes i de skogkledde fjellene i Vietnam.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Fra gibbonaper, makaker, grønne havskilpadder og orientalske kloløse dvergotere til kragebjørner, siamkrokodiller og asiagapenebb. Men dette fristedet er sårbart og helt avhengig av den uforutsigbare nedbøren. Blir Nxai Pan en livgivende oase langs Kalaharis store trekkvei i år, eller bli en dødsfelle i støvet?

programme.title: Rovdyrenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Uansett om det er å søke etter bytte i tropiske løvtak, eller å jakte på et måltid over et moseteppe, er skogsrovdyr avhengige av å ha ferdigheter i å skjule seg for å overleve. programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: De travle vannhullene i Sør-Afrika setter scenen for brutale kamper mellom erkefiender. programme.desc: I Sør-Afrikas villmark blir dyrene desperate i de tørre vintermånedene. Sultne krokodiller sloss mot en farlig gruppe flodhester, flodhestene prøver seg på en gruppe hannløver, en honninggrevling kjemper for livet mot leoparder, og villhunder skaper komplett kaos hvor enn de går.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Når savannen blir en slagmark ser vi på fra sidelinjen når en leopard blir trengt opp i et hjørne av en løveflokk. En ung impala blir kastet opp i luften av en flodhest, to hyener prøver å drukne hverandre og et jordsvin står ansikt til ansikt med en brunhyene.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Livet i den afrikanske bushen er et strategispill for å overleve for de som bor der. Men det mødrene som viser eksepsjonelt mot og styrke når det gjelder å beskytte sine små. De frodige gresslettene byr på gjemmesteder for babyene men også perfekt kamuflasje for luskende rovdyr. Vi ser på de utrolige måtene disse modige matriarkene forer, forsvarer og oppdrar sine barn.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: På en episk safari avslører vi hvordan grensen mellom jeger og bytte hviskes ut i villmarken. Vi ser på utrolige fremvisninger av rå natur, fra elefanter som stormer gjennom bushen med en løve på støttennene til revirkamper mellom hannleoparder, og en flokk hyener som driver bort en løve fra sitt eget bøffelbytte.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Den store julehøytiden er på vei, men alt er ikke like trivelig. Dr. Pol behandler hoven til et reinsdyr før han undersøker en forlatt hundevalp. Dr. Nicole rykker ut til en ku som har oppført seg rart, og dr. Lisa hjelper en katt som sliter med å puste.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.sub-title: Alle for én, og én for Pol
programme.desc: Da en gås, en kanin og en drektig hund kommer til klinikken, samarbeider teamet for å hjelpe dyrene i nød. Dr. Pol ordner gips til en skadet kalv, dr. Lisa jakter på to geiter og dr. Brenda tar grep da symptomene til et reinsdyr plutselig endrer seg.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: De travle vannhullene i Sør-Afrika setter scenen for brutale kamper mellom erkefiender. På vei ut for å se på vilt får vi sete på første rad når løvene benytter seg av kaoset under en stor panikkflukt, og brutalt dreper fire bøfler. Senere er det et annet stort slag som finner sted i en halvveis uttørket elv når en bøffel må kjempe mot fire store kattedyr.

programme.title: Rovdyrenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Uansett om det er å søke etter bytte i tropiske løvtak, eller å jakte på et måltid over et moseteppe, er skogsrovdyr avhengige av å ha ferdigheter i å skjule seg for å overleve. Naturlige instinkter setter inn fra fødselen, og i et tilfelle som aldri før er sett, til og med før fødselen. For første gang fanget på film, se glassfroskfostere klekke tidlig for å unnslippe en lite kjent men dødelig veps, mens faren beskytter babyene med kampsport.

programme.title: Rovdyrenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Rovdyr som lever i åpne områder må kunne gjemme seg for å overleve - eller, som en gruppe manguster: stole på at styrken ligger i antallet.

programme.title: Rovdyrenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Ved utkanten av fjellene, skogene, elvene og havene er naturens jegere tvunget til å spesialisere seg for å overleve.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: På en episk safari avslører vi hvordan grensen mellom jeger og bytte hviskes ut i villmarken.
